description: Structured eval definitions for the Grafana Dashboard Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across data source combinations (CloudWatch, AMP/Prometheus, multi-source with alerting, Enterprise with Incident/OnCall) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production Grafana workspace with CloudWatch data source + alerting
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, CloudWatch data source, customer-managed IAM role, IAM Identity Center auth, dashboard with templating, alerting
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in us-east-1 for production observability. Workspace name "prod-observability". Use IAM Identity Center (AWS_SSO) authentication. Permission type CUSTOMER_MANAGED with a role "GrafanaDataSourceRole" that has CloudWatch read access (cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:ListMetrics, logs:DescribeLogGroups). Data source: CloudWatch for regions us-east-1 and us-west-2. Grafana version 10.4. Dashboard with 12 panels covering EC2, Lambda, and RDS metrics with templating variables for $region and $datasource. Alert rules for CPU > 85% and Lambda errors > 5 with SNS notification to arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:grafana-alerts. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=observability. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WORKSPACE: prod-observability
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace: prod-observability, version: 10.4 (Standard)
  [✓] Authentication: AWS_SSO (IAM Identity Center)
  [✓] Permission type: CUSTOMER_MANAGED
  [✓] IAM role: GrafanaDataSourceRole (cloudwatch:GetMetricData, cloudwatch:ListMetrics, logs:DescribeLogGroups)
  [✓] Data source: CloudWatch (regions: us-east-1, us-west-2)
  [✓] Dashboard: Production Observability (12 panels, templating: $region, $datasource)
  [✓] Alert rules: CPU > 85% (5m for), Lambda errors > 5 (5m for)
  [✓] Notification policies: route by severity
  [✓] Contact points: SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:grafana-alerts
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=observability
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws grafana describe-workspace --workspace-id <workspace-id>
  aws iam get-role --role-name GrafanaDataSourceRole

eval_cases.name: Grafana workspace with AMP/Prometheus data source integration
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — AMP workspace verified ACTIVE, PromQL dashboard with alerting
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in us-east-1 for application monitoring. Workspace name "app-monitoring". IAM Identity Center auth. Permission type CUSTOMER_MANAGED. Data source: AMP/Prometheus. The AMP workspace "prod-metrics" (workspace ID ws-abc123def) is already ACTIVE. Customer-managed IAM role "GrafanaDataSourceRole" with aps:QueryMetrics on the AMP workspace ARN. Grafana version 10.4. Dashboard with service-level metrics (request rate, error rate, latency p99) using PromQL queries against the AMP workspace. Alert on error rate > 1% with SNS notification. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=app-monitoring. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WORKSPACE: app-monitoring
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace: app-monitoring, version: 10.4 (Standard)
  [✓] Authentication: AWS_SSO (IAM Identity Center)
  [✓] Permission type: CUSTOMER_MANAGED
  [✓] IAM role: GrafanaDataSourceRole (aps:QueryMetrics on AMP workspace)
  [✓] Data source: AMP/Prometheus (workspace: ws-abc123def, status: ACTIVE)
  [✓] Dashboard: Application Monitoring (PromQL queries, request rate, error rate, latency p99)
  [✓] Alert rules: error rate > 1% with SNS notification
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=app-monitoring
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws grafana describe-workspace --workspace-id <workspace-id>
  aws amps describe-workspace --workspace-id ws-abc123def
  aws iam get-role --role-name GrafanaDataSourceRole

eval_cases.name: Multi data source (CloudWatch + AMP + X-Ray) with full alerting chain
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi data source, 3-tier dashboard, alert rules + notification policies + contact points
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana workspace in us-east-1 for full-stack observability. Workspace name "fullstack-obs". IAM Identity Center auth. Permission type CUSTOMER_MANAGED. Data sources: CloudWatch (us-east-1), AMP/Prometheus (workspace ws-metrics-xyz, ACTIVE), and X-Ray. IAM role "GrafanaFullStackRole" with read permissions for all three data source types. Grafana version 10.4. Dashboard with 3-tier layout: status overview (stat panels), time-series trends (CPU, latency, throughput from CloudWatch and AMP), detail tables (X-Ray trace summaries). Alert rules: CPU > 85% (CloudWatch), error rate > 1% (AMP PromQL), trace error rate > 5% (X-Ray). Notification policies routing by severity: critical -> sns-critical, warning -> sns-warning. Contact points: SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:grafana-critical and arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:grafana-warning. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=fullstack-observability. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WORKSPACE: fullstack-obs
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace: fullstack-obs, version: 10.4 (Standard)
  [✓] Authentication: AWS_SSO (IAM Identity Center)
  [✓] Permission type: CUSTOMER_MANAGED
  [✓] IAM role: GrafanaFullStackRole (CloudWatch + AMP + X-Ray read)
  [✓] Data source: CloudWatch (us-east-1)
  [✓] Data source: AMP/Prometheus (workspace: ws-metrics-xyz, ACTIVE)
  [✓] Data source: X-Ray
  [✓] Dashboard: Full-Stack Observability (3-tier layout, templating: $datasource)
  [✓] Alert rules: CPU > 85% (CW), error rate > 1% (AMP), trace error > 5% (X-Ray)
  [✓] Notification policies: severity=critical -> sns-critical, severity=warning -> sns-warning
  [✓] Contact points: SNS grafana-critical + grafana-warning
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=fullstack-observability
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws grafana describe-workspace --workspace-id <workspace-id>
  aws amps describe-workspace --workspace-id ws-metrics-xyz
  aws iam get-role --role-name GrafanaFullStackRole

eval_cases.name: Grafana Enterprise workspace with Incident + OnCall + 5 data sources
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Enterprise tier, SAML team sync, Incident, OnCall, 5 data sources
eval_cases.prompt: Create an Amazon Managed Grafana Enterprise workspace in us-east-1 for enterprise observability. Workspace name "enterprise-obs". SAML authentication with team sync from the corporate IdP. Permission type CUSTOMER_MANAGED. Data sources: CloudWatch, AMP (workspace ws-prod-metrics, ACTIVE), Timestream, OpenSearch (domain prod-logs), X-Ray. Grafana version 11.0. Enable Grafana Incident for real-time incident declaration and tracking. Enable Grafana OnCall for escalation schedule management with integration to Slack channel #oncall-platform. IAM role "GrafanaEnterpriseRole" with read access to all data source types. Dashboard suite: executive overview, service health, incident response. Alerting with escalation policy: severity=critical pages on-call immediately, severity=warning notifies Slack channel. Tags: Environment=production, Workload=enterprise-observability, Tier=enterprise. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WORKSPACE: enterprise-obs
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Workspace: enterprise-obs, version: 11.0 (Enterprise)
  [✓] Authentication: SAML with team sync from IdP
  [✓] Permission type: CUSTOMER_MANAGED
  [✓] IAM role: GrafanaEnterpriseRole (CloudWatch + AMP + Timestream + OpenSearch + X-Ray read)
  [✓] Data source: CloudWatch, AMP (ws-prod-metrics ACTIVE), Timestream, OpenSearch (prod-logs), X-Ray
  [✓] Grafana Incident: Enabled (real-time incident declaration)
  [✓] Grafana OnCall: Enabled (escalation schedules, Slack #oncall-platform)
  [✓] Dashboard suite: executive overview, service health, incident response
  [✓] Alerting: critical pages on-call, warning notifies Slack
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Workload=enterprise-observability, Tier=enterprise
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws grafana describe-workspace --workspace-id <workspace-id>
  aws amps describe-workspace --workspace-id ws-prod-metrics
  aws iam get-role --role-name GrafanaEnterpriseRole

eval_cases.name: Operator missing IAM Identity Center and IAM role — prerequisites missing
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — IAM Identity Center not enabled, no IAM role, no AMP workspace
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create a Managed Grafana workspace called "team-dashboards" in us-east-1. I want CloudWatch and AMP data sources. I haven't enabled IAM Identity Center yet and I don't have an IAM role for data source access. I also don't have an AMP workspace set up. Account ID: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WORKSPACE: team-dashboards
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] IAM Identity Center: NOT enabled — required for AWS_SSO authentication (recommended auth mode)
  [✗] IAM role: NOT provided — customer-managed role with data source read permissions required
  [✗] AMP workspace: NOT created — required for Prometheus data source integration
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws sso-admin list-instances
  aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(RoleName, `Grafana`)]'
  aws amps list-workspaces
